notes.title: NEW Bit Lost Split-Screen Mode
notes.content:
[p]NEW Major Update — Split-Screen Mode Added! [/p][p]Bit Lost now features a local split-screen cooperative mode![/p][p] Play together on one screen: One player on keyboard + mouse, the other on a gamepad. No extra setup — just select Split Mode in the main menu and dive into the new simulation. What’s in the new mode: A short but atmospheric co-op experience; Puzzles that require teamwork; A chill zone with a shooting range and a small reward; An unexpected ending — only one can leave... Also included: small bug fixes and improvements to physics in the base game.[/p][p] --- Important: By purchasing Bit Lost, you're not just getting a game — you’re unlocking access to all future additional modes based on player feedback. All updates will be completely free and included in the base price. Everything depends on you. Share your thoughts, ideas, and help shape the project.[/p][p] --- Thanks for your support. Bit Lost isn’t just a game — it’s a journey, and you're part of it.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675189/c20d85a00906ba33d9b0af5a4889bf53caefd510.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Bit Lost Update: New Stories & Free Roam Mode!
notes.content: [p]🛠️ Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I wanted to share a few things coming in the next planned update for Bit Lost:[/p][p][/p][p]🧠 Additional storylines — you’ll experience short episodes told from the perspective of other test subjects, each with their own atmosphere, thoughts, and fragments of truth. These stories will add more depth to the world and hint at what lies beneath.[/p][p][/p][p]🚀 Free roam / Jump Level Mode — a separate map with an extended route, perfect for exploring and just moving around freely. A chill experience for anyone who wants more room to breathe.[/p][p][/p][p]💡 All of this will be available completely free for everyone who supports the game![/p][p][/p][p]⚙️ Unexpected fixes and improvements will also be released as quickly as possible, based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Always open to your suggestions — thank you to everyone who's supported Bit Lost so far. This is only the beginning. 🙌[/p]

notes.title: First Patch – Post-Launch Improvements
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Thanks so much for playing the game and supporting it during launch! 🙌[/p][p]This first update is focused on small improvements and fixes to make the experience smoother for everyone. Here's what's new:[/p][p]🟢 New Game Confirmation:[/p][p]A confirmation step was added before starting a new simulation to help prevent accidental overwrites.[/p][p]📄 Note Readability Improvements:[/p][p]Several in-game notes were difficult to read due to lighting or placement — these have been adjusted for better visibility.[/p][p]🛠️ Minor Fixes and Stability Improvements:[/p][p]A few small bugs have been resolved to improve the overall flow and performance.[/p][p]🏆 Achievement support has begun![/p][p]A first test achievement is now available in the game, and more will be added in future updates. Stay tuned — and good luck unlocking them all![/p][p]That’s it for this update![/p][p]More patches and feature improvements are coming soon — stay tuned, and thanks again for being part of the launch! 🚀[/p][p]I'm always open to feedback and would love to hear your thoughts or suggestions on how to improve the game.[/p]
